text:
Based on the Disbursement Register sheet the Amount column was normalised to INR

* ₹1,20,000 → 120000
* 1.2 L → 120000
* 2.5 lakh → 250000
* 1 Cr → 10 000 000
* 45k → 45 000
* blank / ‘-’ / NA → 0

The valid MU- rows are 180. Programme row counts on the filtered register are

* Maternal & Child Health : 52
* Rural Livelihoods : 49
* Water & Sanitation : 41
* Tribal Education : 38

With the mixed-unit amounts parsed to INR and summed per Programme, Maternal & Child Health has the largest aggregate disbursement, consistent with it having the greatest number of disbursement records and the highest summed INR total in the FY 2025-26 register.

ANSWER: Maternal & Child Health
